subject.title: ci: hourly sweeper re-fires dropped pull_request CI runs

question: Should this repository permit manual execution of the CI sweeper only from trusted default-branch code before the Barnacle App token is created?
rationale: The intended recovery automation is useful, but choosing to allow selected-ref code in a credentialed workflow would define a security boundary that cannot safely be inferred from the PR’s operational goal.

options.title: Restrict to trusted main
options.body: Require workflow_dispatch to use the default branch and explicitly check out that trusted revision before the token and dynamic import.

options.title: Accept selected-ref execution
options.body: Keep arbitrary selected refs dispatchable and explicitly accept that collaborators with dispatch access can run branch code using the App token.

recommendation.title: Restrict to trusted main
recommendation.body: Require workflow_dispatch to use the default branch and explicitly check out that trusted revision before the token and dynamic import.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context shows prior ownership of the CI-drop diagnosis and the proposed Barnacle-based recovery implementation.
